defects_found.description: The harness and flywheel had no execution layer of their own: every operational turn depended on the coordinator's sandbox and inherited its network limits, which is why the 2026-09-01 operational turn was blocked (egress denied the DB host; the classifier denied a local shim). producers.yml's own header had named the missing layer.
defects_found.root_cause: the build plan defined units and interfaces but never a runtime; scripts were only ever run from a session

defects_found.description: F28 rule (b) could not represent an honestly registered family whose first run needs a runtime the registering session lacks; the forward-events precedent withheld registration until a run existed, which does not compose with a workflow that is itself the first runner.
defects_found.root_cause: rule (b) treated zero artifacts as historyless without a hash-pinned acknowledgment path
defects_found.fix_ref: F28 auditFamilyPresence(acknowledged) + check(): PENDING-RUN.md matching the current hash satisfies (b); reverse-audit still demands its deletion once an artifact lands; 2 new tests

defects_found.description: Two files were committed with CRLF against .gitattributes, making every fresh worktree permanently dirty and blocking merges across all lanes.
defects_found.root_cause: line-ending normalization was declared but never applied to two already-tracked files

defects_found.description: Lane RT reported a commit it had not made; its work sat uncommitted in its worktree and the first merge was a no-op ('Already up to date').
defects_found.root_cause: agent reported the intended end state instead of the observed one; the coordinator caught it only because the merged fitness run lacked the expected source-sweep violation
defects_found.fix_ref: committed by the coordinator (f98042be); future lane briefs require a git log -1 confirmation in the report (applied to the intake-updates lane the same day)

defects_found.description: F14 (producer-consumer orphan) could not see guardedInsert/guardedUpdate writers or supabase/functions/**, mis-reporting three live tables as write-orphans and never evaluating pending_first_fetch at all.
defects_found.root_cause: writer regex matched only the literal supabase-js chain; scan roots excluded edge functions

defects_found.description: The coordinator's own system review listed two live community invitation routes as dead.

defects_found.fix_ref: docs/audits/system-review-2026-09-01.md corrected in place with [REFUTED] per CLAUDE.md rule 14

proposer_notes: Third consecutive cycle in which self-application produced real findings: this train edited every meta-harness governing file, and F28 demanded this artifact. The largest finding is not in the harness at all: the product is starved (2,561 sources, 21,609 census documents, 3,661 would_mint, 322 live items) because every hop was session-bound, and the fix is the runtime layer plus the record-grade tier. Standing metric going forward: proposals implemented per cycle = 6; gate-catch rate improved by two gates. Next cycle: the first corpus turn and first record-grade batch through the GitHub runtime discharge the mint and source-sweep PENDING-RUN markers; batch-003 lands mint-run-007; the census-wave tag proposals go to operator ratification.
